# N27: The rail’s Faro mark opens the workspace switcher, the Demo box stays on screen, and Escape returns focus to the mark

A check of the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/notes/22-rail-switch.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured, and a limit its words don’t give is added after it, in the script’s test (“its test: …”).

## What it checks

the switcher on the icon rail (small workspaces SM4, 2.6). [RAIL-SWITCH] At 1024 × 768 the rail's Faro mark is the switcher: it names itself "{workspace}: switch workspace, or set one up", opens the Workspaces panel, and Escape puts focus back on it. No row is added to the rail, so the Demo box stays fully on screen (P10).

## Where it looks

- 1024 × 768, as rhea, at `/`

A width of 390 is a phone, 1440 (or 1280) a desktop; the address is in the demo on Thursday 5 November 2026 unless it names another day. {…} is a value the script works out as it runs.

## What it reports as wrong

- the rail has no switcher on its Faro mark
- the Demo box is not fully on screen at 1024 × 768 ({demo ? `${Math.round(demo.top)}–${Math.round(demo.bottom)}px of ${demo.h}` : 'missing'}) (its test: `demo.top >= 0`)
- the mark does not open the Workspaces panel
- the panel has no “Set up a new workspace” (its test: `.count() > 0`)
- after Escape, focus is not back on the rail’s mark
